svg.text: SMB1 stays off whenever the server speaks SMB 2 or 3 (every Windows server since 2008, nearly every NAS). It is not installed by default

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: since Windows 10 version 1709, and MS17-010 (EternalBlue) powered WannaCry and NotPetya. Turning the feature off is the repair; turning it on is an exception.
